text:
Мужик оставил дома пейджер, вечером возвращается, читает сообщения. Первое:
— Милый, дорогой, любимый, позвони мне пожалуйста. Целую, всегда твоя Марина. Второе:
— Я уже позвонила, можешь не беспокоиться. Твоя жена.
gist: A man who forgot his pager at home finds a loving message from his mistress asking him to call, followed by one from his wife saying she already called her.

text:
У одного мужика был кот. И то ли старый котяра уже стал, то ли сметану спер, но жена мужика приказала отнести его далеко в лес и оставить там на произвол судьбы. Делать нечего - понес мужик кота в лес. И сам пропал. День его нет, два нет, на третий день появляется дома кот, и тут же мужик следом - грязный, злой и голодный.
— Ну ты чего, урод, отнес кота в лес? - напустилась на него жена.
— Ага, отнес, блин! И если бы за ним следом не пошел, заблудился бы на хрен...
gist: A man ordered by his wife to abandon the cat in the forest returns after the cat, admitting he would have been lost if he had not followed it home.

characters.looks: dirty, angry, hungry man with twigs in his hair
stern woman with hands on hips
old fat tabby cat, smug expression

text:
Мужик утром просыпается с глубочайшего похмелья от телефонного звонка, звонит друг, которого он давно не видел.
— Ты откуда? - спрашивает мужик. Тот в ответ:
— Выручай, друг, из вытрезвителя звоню, недалеко от твоего дома, денег нет, надо 156 рублей, чтобы отпустили. Мужик обещает, кладет трубку и, собрав остаток сил, поднимается и начинает медленно одеваться, стараясь не упасть. Жена грозно:
— Куда??? Тот честно объясняет ситуацию. Жена пристально смотрит на его опухшую физиономию и говорит:
— 312 рублей возьми!!!
gist: A hungover man's friend calls from the sobering-up station asking for release money, and the man's wife, seeing his state, tells him to take double so he can pay for himself too.

characters.looks: puffy hungover face, rumpled undershirt, unsteady
sheepish man on payphone, crumpled clothes
stern woman, bathrobe, arms crossed

adaptNote: sobering-up station -> drunk tank; convert sum, keep the doubling

text:
A woman and her lover were in bed, when the woman heard her husband getting back.
The woman said “Quick! Rub baby powder on you and pretend to be a statue.” The lover did that.
The husband walked into the room.
“Honey, what’s this statue doing here?” He asked.
“I saw that the Smiths got one, so I decided to get one as well.” She replied.
The husband got into bed, and the woman fell asleep. A few hours later, after checking his wife was asleep, he quietly got up, walked into  kitchen, made a sandwich and got a glass of milk, came back, and went to the statue.
“Here, have something to eat and drink. I stood like an idiot for 3 days at the Smiths, and no one offered me anything to eat!”
gist: Wife disguises her lover as a statue; at night the husband brings the statue food, saying nobody fed him when he stood as a statue at the neighbors'.

characters.looks: panicked woman in nightgown
man covered in white powder, frozen pose
husband in pajamas, sandwich and milk glass

adaptNote: Rename the Smiths to local neighbors.

text:
While picking up a turkey for this Thanksgiving, I overheard this gem.
A lady was picking through the frozen turkeys, but she couldn't find one big enough for her family.
She asked a stock boy, "Do these turkeys get any bigger?"
The stock boy replied, "No ma'am, they’re dead."
gist: A shopper asks if the frozen turkeys get any bigger, and the clerk literally answers that they cannot grow because they are dead.

wordplay.explanation: 'Get any bigger' means larger sizes available or growing larger.

characters.looks: middle-aged woman digging through a freezer
teenage stock boy in store apron

adaptNote: Phrase the question so it can mean both 'bigger sizes' and 'will they grow'; swap Thanksgiving for New Year.

text:
I called my wife at work and asked, "Do you ever get a shooting pain across your body, like someone's got a voodoo doll of you and they're stabbing it?" Sounding concerned, she said, "No."
I responded, "How about now?"
gist: A husband calls his wife asking about voodoo-doll stabbing pains, and when she says no he asks 'how about now?', revealing he has the doll.

text:
My wife is pregnant and my doctor asked me if I had ever been present at a childbirth before.
I replied, "Yes just once."
The doctor asked, "What was it like?"
I said, "It was dark, then suddenly very bright."
gist: An expectant father says he was present at one childbirth before, and his description of darkness then sudden light reveals it was his own birth.

characters.looks: nervous young man, expectant father
doctor in white coat, stethoscope, clipboard
pregnant woman
